text:
eli: Heads-up — customer (AcmeAI) escalated: invoice shows ~1.2M more tokens than their dashboard for 03/10 14:00-14:45 UTC. Ticket #1428. I can see error spikes in our ingest logs during that window. Need SRE + Billing to triage.

maya: On it. Kinesis throttled writes 14:05->14:22, backpressure to meter-ingest. Logs show repeated `PUT 429` from ingest-proxy. Making timeline now.

jon: Dashboard reads from `metering_aggregates_v2` which got partial writes. Invoice pipeline reads raw_event_store — if replayed events were ingested later without dedupe, invoices could include duplicates.

eli: Customer reports dashboard was lower during window (so undercount) but invoice is higher — sounds like invoice included replayed events while dashboard didn't reflect them after backfill. Need reconciliation + backfill.

kevin: Confirming invoice job ran 03/11 00:00 UTC and consumed raw_event_store. I see a backlog cleared by a replay at ~03/11 02:00 that includes events from the 03/10 window. Operator used `replay-tool --from=1718007000 --to=1718010000 --no-dedupe` when clearing the backlog.

maya: That `--no-dedupe` was not intended. I'm starting a controlled deduped replay into metrics only. Stopping any further non-deduped replays now.

sarah: Customer wants an immediate explanation and potential credit. Proposed external message: apologize, show reconciliation numbers, offer pro-rated credit for overcharge. Need final numbers by EOD.

jon: Running query to quantify duplicates: ```
SELECT event_id, COUNT(*) c
FROM raw_events
WHERE ts BETWEEN TIMESTAMP_SECONDS(1718007000) AND TIMESTAMP_SECONDS(1718010000)
GROUP BY event_id
HAVING c > 1
ORDER BY c DESC
LIMIT 10;
```
Results show ~1.16M duplicate event occurrences. Exporting dup ids to gs://redwood-backfill/dups-171800.csv

eli: Action items: 1) SRE to halt non-deduped replays, 2) Eng to run deduped replay into metrics only and recompute aggregates, 3) Billing to compute invoice delta + prepare adjustment, 4) Support to update customer. I'll open a consolidated incident PR.

micah: FYI I killed the rogue replay process around 14:30 UTC but it had already emitted to invoice-topic. Suggest tagging those invoice entries with `replay_source=manual` so invoice code can exclude them during correction.

kevin: Billing can issue a credit, but we need an auditable token delta and rollbackable metadata. ETA to compute reconciliation: ~6 hours if eng provides cleaned aggregates.

eli: Pushed summary to #incidents and linked logs: https://logs.redwood.internal/ingest/1718009123. Commands I used for safe check: ```/tools/replay --src=raw --dst=metrics --from=1718007000 --to=1718010000 --dedupe=true --check-only``` 

sarah: Customer replied: "Thanks, please expedite. Month-end close is tomorrow." :pray:

jon: After deduped replay and recompute, metrics now align with expected event counts minus duplicated writes. Patch shows adjusted token count: -1,160,432 tokens. Uploaded diff + audit CSV: gs://billing-adjustments/acmeai/1718009123-diff.csv

eli: Billing created adjustment and updated invoice metadata with `correction_incident=INC-2024-318`. Support notified customer and provided credit note. Postmortem scheduled for next week to cover operator training + safer replay-tool defaults. :white_check_mark:

maya: Follow-ups: (a) add server-side guard to reject `--no-dedupe` unless `--confirm-unsafe`, (b) add replay dry-run that prints estimated token delta, (c) alert on Kinesis write-429 spikes tied to meter-ingest.

sarah: I'll send the customer the reconciliation statement and confirmation of the credit.

eli: Closing loop in this thread — will attach incident PR with timeline, logs, queries, and billing artifacts. If anyone else wants to add details to INC-2024-318, ping me.
